sources.beginner: hand-calc: blend-on-the-right-basis closed forms (SG on volume, per-mass properties, mass shares, CII, TBP interpolation) taught in /root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/content/courses/crude/beginner/m02,m04,m05; all six reproduced exactly. Suite Crude Assay & Blending Studio (/opt/petrolord-studio/workspaces/dev1/projects/petrolord-suite/src/components/crudeassay/BlendResults.jsx) prints 1 to 3 dp; crude-assay-explorer runs the OBIGBO library only.
sources.intermediate: hand-calc: blend TBP curve at every measured temperature, inverse interpolation for T50, cut differences and the netback formula, taught in /root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/content/courses/crude/intermediate/m01-m04; all six reproduced exactly. Studio YieldsPanel.jsx prints 1 to 2 dp; crude-valuation-explorer runs KWALE only.
sources.advanced: suite-app: the ONNE least-cost LP needs a solver; lessons teach the engine and name the Product Blending Optimizer (/opt/petrolord-studio/workspaces/dev1/projects/petrolord-suite/src/components/blendoptimizer/RecipeResults.jsx, PoolPanel.jsx), which prints total 0 dp, volumes 1 dp, shadow prices 2 dp against tol 5e-5; crude-recipe-explorer runs Apapa/textbook/default pool only.

fields.prompt_precision: Give six numbers, each to four decimals.
fields.evidence: SG=141.5/(API+131.5) per crude, volume-weighted SG, back to API; reproduced exactly (33.76556073569742).
fields.notes: Prompt: 'Give six numbers, each to four decimals.' tol 5e-5 equals half a unit in the fourth decimal (precision.json, wave.json grading.tolerance), so a correctly rounded full-precision answer always passes. The Suite Crude Assay & Blending Studio can also run the case but prints fewer decimals (BlendResults.jsx:68 fmt(p.api, 2)), so a learner who reads it instead of computing would miss the tol; the prompt does not name the studio. No probe number within tol (nearest probe values differ by over 1e-3 relative).

fields.display_ref: src/components/blendoptimizer/RecipeResults.jsx:56 Total at 6 dp with Full precision on
fields.prompt_precision: Give six numbers, each to four decimals.
fields.recommendation: Print four decimals in the Product Blending Optimizer (matches the prompt and the course's four-decimal convention). Alternative is loosening tol to half a unit of what the app prints, which contradicts the prompt's 'to four decimals'. Also consider naming the Product Blending Optimizer in the prompt, since the ONNE LP cannot be run in any NextGen panel.
fields.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 6 decimals (jest: blendFullPrecision.test.jsx, the solver result through formatFull).
fields.notes: LP (5 components, 7 rows) needs a solver: the lessons teach the engine/kernel (optimiseBlend, solveLP) and name the Product Blending Optimizer (advanced/m01/l01 line 23, m06/l01 line 39) and never teach a spreadsheet Solver route, so per the brief the app is the source. crude-recipe-explorer runs only Apapa, the textbook LP and the default pool (RecipeExplorer.jsx:179, 295), not ONNE. The ONNE spec equals the app's gasoline_50ppm template (productBlending.js:520-526) and every component property is enterable (PoolPanel.jsx:43-54); running the Suite engine on K.ONNE_POOL reproduces expected exactly. No probe number within tol. Probe prints 872711.745212 (the Apapa-shaped default), not within tol.
